fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance to help responders locate the property quickly from the road.
• Trim vegetation along both sides of the access drive to maintain clear vehicle width for emergency apparatus.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles to allow unobstructed movement between the road and the residence.
• Mark or identify the detached structure with a visible label or number so responders can distinguish it from the main residence on arrival.
• Clear a walking path between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between buildings without navigating dense vegetation.
• Thin shrubs and low-hanging branches along the rear of the property to allow responders to reach the back of the residence on foot.
• Designate a flat, open area near the access drive as a staging area where emergency vehicles can park without blocking the drive.
• Keep a gate or secondary opening accessible at the rear of the property if one exists, so responders are not forced to return to the single front access point.
• Trim vegetation that obstructs sightlines from the access drive to the main residence and detached structure.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim tree branches that hang close to the house on all sides to create open space between the tree canopy and the structure.
• Thin scattered trees near the house so they do not connect directly to each other or to the structure.
• Cut or mow grass growing close to the house and any outbuildings down to a short, manageable height.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against or within a few feet of the structure.
• Thin shrubs scattered around the property so they do not form a continuous line leading toward the house.
• Separate shrub clusters from nearby trees so neither connects to the other near the structure.
• Keep the single driveway clear of overhanging branches, shrubs, and tall grass along both sides for its full length.
• Keep the driveway surface free of debris and vegetation so emergency vehicles can travel it without obstruction.
• Mark the driveway entrance clearly so it is visible to approaching emergency vehicles.
• Maintain a wide enough opening at the driveway entry to allow large emergency vehicles to enter without difficulty.
• Keep open terrain areas near the house clear of new shrub or grass growth that could close the gap between vegetation and the structure.
• Remove dead or dry plant material from around trees and shrubs near the house.
